datasets.name: DeepResearch Bench II
datasets.upstream_revision: main (pin an immutable commit before publishing scored comparisons)

license_policy.notes: Upstream says each task follows its source article license. Per-record license metadata is mandatory; unknown license rows are rejected.

datasets.annotation_provenance: Expert-authored source reports; rubric items are LLM-extracted, manually revised and expert-reviewed. Per-run rubric scores are produced by an LLM judge, not human labels for every evaluated agent response.
datasets.leaderboard_note: The upstream project reported that tasks 112 and 114 were temporarily excluded from leaderboard scoring pending expert review/repair in its Aug 2026 update. The adapter preserves the full source task set and does not silently apply a leaderboard-specific filter.

score_semantics.1: rubric satisfied with valid evidence and no blocked reference
score_semantics.-1: rubric mentioned but evidence relies on a blocked reference

datasets.corpus_policy: Load the upstream task/rubric file locally. Do not vendor it as a project dataset. Record the file SHA-256 and task-level license in each experiment.

datasets.name: FRAMES: Factuality, Retrieval, And reasoning MEasurement Set
datasets.upstream_revision: main (pin the Hugging Face dataset commit and local file SHA-256 for each experiment)

license_policy.notes: The dataset supplies question/answer labels and Wikipedia article URLs. This adapter stores only those URLs, not article text; underlying Wikipedia content remains governed by its own license.

datasets.annotation_provenance: Dataset-provided gold answers and relevant article URLs. The dataset card does not establish individual annotator identities or inter-annotator agreement; do not label these as adjudicated human claim annotations.
datasets.corpus_policy: Use the supplied article URLs as relevance labels. Do not automatically fetch or snapshot Wikipedia pages through this adapter.

datasets.name: BrowseComp-Plus
datasets.upstream_revision: main (pin the upstream repository and dataset revisions for reproducible experiments)

license_policy.notes: The Hugging Face dataset card carries an MIT label. The corpus contains crawled web documents; that label must not be assumed to clear rights in every underlying webpage. This integration discards document bodies and retains only IDs and URL judgements.

datasets.annotation_provenance: Upstream describes evidence documents as human-verified and distinguishes evidence documents from gold documents. The labels are document-level retrieval judgements, not human rubric scores of generated reports.
datasets.corpus_policy: Use the official upstream de-obfuscation/download workflow to create a local JSONL. The 100,195-document corpus is optional for retrieval experiments and is never copied by this project adapter.
